title: security-prior-art-survey extract output (parsed frontmatter)
description: The YAML frontmatter of an extract/<item_id>.md record: a discriminated union of a full extraction and a relevance-bail skip. The markdown body below the frontmatter carries the analysis and is checked separately for its required headings. Evolves additively only; enums are frozen-but-extensible.

item_id.description: The source item's own identifier, in the form its class allows.

skip.description: Required when outcome is skipped. The relevance bail is the ONLY cut in this survey, and it fires only on a confident 'applies to none of the scope' — uncertainty keeps the item.

reason.description: irrelevant: applies to none of the scope. unavailable: the item exists but could not be retrieved. withdrawn: the source retracted it.

bail_rationale.description: Why none of the scope is touched, specifically. A one-word rationale is not a rationale.

checked_scope.description: The scope elements actually considered before bailing — capabilities, stack or dependency names, surfaces.

cause.description: Required when reason is unavailable or withdrawn.

surfaces.description: Required when extracted: the product surfaces this item applies to, named from the caller's scope.

tier.description: Evidence tier. 1 = exploited in the wild against products like ours. 2 = proven exploitable, not observed here. 3 = documented pattern with no observed exploitation. Assigned from evidence, never from severity.

tier_evidence.description: Required when tier is 1 or 2: what puts it there. A tier claim with no evidence is the failure this field exists to prevent.

severity.description: Required when extracted. A LIST, never a bare number: scoring systems are not comparable across versions, and a record must not imply they are. Empty is legitimate for an item whose source publishes no score.

control.description: Required when extracted: the control this item's own source prescribes. Never invented — where the source states none, say so.

text.description: Required when stated is true: the control as the source puts it.

source_reference.description: Required when stated is true: where in the source it says so.

aliases.description: Other identifiers for THIS SAME item. What lets synthesis collapse one vulnerability carrying two database ids into one register row.

related.description: Identifiers of NEIGHBOURING items — a parent weakness class, a sibling technique. Distinct from aliases; conflating them is a known modelling error that corrupts deduplication.

url.description: Required when id_class is non-registry: the stable location the item was read from.
